enrichr.note: Enrichment is queried live, but each library is requested BY EXACT NAME, so the live API returns the PINNED snapshot (GO_Biological_Process_2023, Reactome_Pathways_2024, WikiPathways_2019_Human, KEGG_2021_Human), not the newest version. Newer libraries exist (verified 2026-11-20 via Enrichr datasetStatistics): GO_Biological_Process_2026 (5,954 terms), WikiPathways_2024_Human (829), KEGG_2026 (352); Reactome_Pathways_2024 is the only Reactome version listed. Updating a library means changing its name in the engine and re-running the calibration (docs/validation/calibration-enrichr-route.md). Local GMT copies are bundled for the offline path; KEGG is fetched on demand by the updater, never bundled (see DATA_LICENSES.md).

mirbase.note: Installed 23.1 on 2026-11-18 via the updater (mature.fa 74,463 entries, hairpin.fa 46,603). Thesis validated names against v22; v23 (Aug 2026) added 8,847 hairpins and 27,005 mature products and renamed entries (e.g. hsa-miR-107 -> hsa-miR-107-3p).

mirtarbase.local: miRTarBase 10.0 official index (hsa_MTI.csv, 4,004,967 rows, 3,048 miRNAs, 1,730,805 pairs; built 2026-11-21)
mirtarbase.note: Validated targets served LOCALLY from the official miRTarBase 10.0 index (local_db/mirtarbase_v10.json.gz, built by build_mirtarbase_official.py from the user's own download of hsa_MTI.csv). The 9.0 index (local_db/mirtarbase_official.json.gz, 396,758 pairs) is kept alongside it; KENRYU_MIRTARBASE_VERSION=9.0 reproduces old results. Levels: strong = Functional MTI with PMID (+30), weak = Functional MTI (Weak) with PMID (+15), clip_only = Functional MTI (Weak) with NO PMID, all experiments CLIP (1,411,229 pairs, 82.0% of weak; visible, +0 points, never unlocks 'alta'), none = Non-Functional rows. Bare miRNA names (no -5p/-3p arm) are marked 'brazo no especificado'. Live Harmonizome API only a fallback. The old Harmonizome GMT snapshot (local_db/mirtarbase_gene_set_library.gmt.gz, 596 rows: 576 hsa-miRNAs + 20 rows from other species) is kept as a fallback when no official index is present. Redistribution terms: the v9.0 LICENSE is archived (academic use free, 'AS IS'); the v10.0 terms could not be verified (no archived copy; live site 404) — so the v10.0 index is built on the user's machine and is never committed nor shipped to the public Space, which keeps serving v9.0 (see docs/validation/mirtarbase-v10-adoption.md, step A; DATA_LICENSES.md). The raw files are never committed.

hgnc.latest_known: 2026-11-21 (download date; HGNC publishes no release number)
hgnc.note: Symbol map (local_db/hgnc_symbol_map.json, 498 entries, built by scripts/build_hgnc_symbol_map.py): TargetScan genes absent from the enrichment libraries with a unique current HGNC symbol in the libraries (487 in GO/Reactome/WikiPathways + 11 via KEGG only). Applied at load to TargetScan sets and miRTarBase index keys since v1.59; ambiguous genes (3) are never mapped, and neither are genes that are themselves Approved HGNC symbols (1,504 current genes the libraries lack stay untouched). Universe 13,035 -> 13,016 distinct symbols. HGNC data: CC0 1.0 (https://www.genenames.org/about/license/).
